topic: Should AI tools be allowed in classrooms?
positions: AI tools should be allowed with clear rules.
AI tools should be restricted in most classroom work.

topic: Should schools move to a four-day academic week?
positions: A four-day academic week would improve learning and wellbeing.
Schools should keep a five-day academic week.

topic: Should schools require uniforms?
positions: School uniforms should be required.
Students should be allowed to choose their own school clothing within basic rules.

topic: Is remote work better than office-first work?
positions: Remote work should be the default when the job allows it.
Office-first work is better for most teams.

topic: Should social media platforms have stricter age limits?
positions: Platforms should enforce stricter age limits.
Current age limits are sufficient when properly enforced.

topic: Should public speaking be a required school skill?
positions: Every student should complete formal public-speaking work.
Public speaking should remain optional.

topic: Are group projects worth keeping in education?
positions: Group projects teach skills that individual work cannot.
Group projects create too many unfair grading problems.

topic: Should businesses move toward cashless payments?
positions: Businesses should be encouraged to become cashless.
Businesses should always retain a cash-payment option.

topic: Should companies adopt a four-day workweek?
positions: A four-day workweek should become a common option.
A five-day workweek remains more practical for most businesses.

topic: Should workplaces have formal dress codes?
positions: Formal dress codes improve professionalism.
Workplaces should judge performance rather than clothing.

topic: Should schools start later in the morning?
positions: Schools should start later.
Schools should keep early start times for scheduling and family needs.

topic: Should homework be reduced?
positions: Schools should substantially reduce homework.
Homework remains an important part of learning.

topic: Should competitive gaming be treated as a legitimate sport?
positions: Competitive gaming should be recognized as a sport.
Competitive gaming should remain a separate category from traditional sport.

topic: Should public libraries receive more funding?
positions: Public libraries should receive increased public funding.
Libraries should operate mainly within existing budgets.

topic: Should cities prioritize public transportation over private cars?
positions: Cities should prioritize public transportation infrastructure.
Cities should balance public transport with private-car infrastructure.

topic: Should fast fashion face stricter environmental rules?
positions: Fast fashion needs stronger environmental regulation.
Consumer choice and industry innovation are better than stricter rules.

topic: Should animal testing be reduced wherever alternatives exist?
positions: Animal testing should be reduced whenever reliable alternatives exist.
Animal testing should remain available where it is scientifically necessary.

topic: Should governments spend more on space exploration?
positions: Space exploration deserves greater public investment.
Governments should prioritize terrestrial needs over additional space spending.

topic: Should schools provide free meals to every student?
positions: Schools should provide free meals to all students.
Free school meals should be targeted to students who need them.

topic: Should major exams carry less weight than coursework?
positions: Coursework should carry more weight than final exams.
Major exams should remain the main measure of academic performance.

topic: Should smartphones be banned during class?
positions: Smartphones should be prohibited during lessons.
Students should be allowed to use smartphones under classroom rules.

topic: Can online learning replace most traditional classroom learning?
positions: Online learning can replace much traditional classroom work.
Traditional classrooms remain essential for most students.

topic: Should schools spend more time on arts and creative subjects?
positions: Arts and creative subjects deserve more curriculum time.
Core academic subjects should remain the priority.

topic: Will workplace automation create more opportunities than it removes?
positions: Automation will create more opportunities in the long run.
Automation will remove more opportunities than it creates without strong adaptation.

topic: Should people trade some digital privacy for convenience?
positions: Limited privacy tradeoffs can be reasonable for useful services.
Digital privacy should take priority over convenience.

topic: Should media literacy be a required school subject?
positions: Media literacy should be a required subject.
Media literacy should be integrated into existing subjects instead.

topic: Should employees receive more pay based on individual performance?
positions: Performance-based pay can reward strong contributions.
Pay should primarily reflect role, responsibility, and stable salary structures.

topic: Should more exams be open-book?
positions: Open-book exams can better test reasoning and application.
Closed-book exams remain important for testing independent recall.

topic: Should community service be required for graduation?
positions: Community service should be a graduation requirement.
Community service should remain voluntary.

topic: Is failure an essential part of learning?
positions: Meaningful failure is an essential part of learning.
Learning can be effective without deliberately relying on failure.
